Advanced Seismic Data Processing Solutions Market
column2: Companies that develop or license seismic data PROCESSING software, algorithms, imaging platforms or related computational solutions used for SUBSURFACE EXPLORATION in oil, gas and minerals — depth imaging, migration, full-waveform inversion, velocity modelling, interpretation and seismic data analytics. EXCLUDE earthquake or structural-engineering seismology, seismic hazard monitoring networks, and survey acquisition hardware such as sensors, nodes, streamers and vessels.

column1: Marine Seismic Data Processing Services Market
column2: Service providers that PROCESS, IMAGE, and INTERPRET marine (offshore) seismic datasets for hydrocarbon exploration and appraisal, encompassing advanced imaging techniques including Full Waveform Inversion (FWI), Reverse Time Migration (RTM), Least-Squares Migration, Depth Imaging, Velocity Model Building, Multiple Attenuation, and Broadband Processing. EXCLUDE standalone software/license vendors who do not themselves execute processing services on client data — a company that only sells or licenses processing SOFTWARE, with no in-house team that runs it on a client's actual seismic data, does not qualify. Also EXCLUDE onshore-only seismic processors, earthquake or structural-engineering seismology, seismic hazard monitoring networks, and survey acquisition hardware such as sensors, nodes, streamers and vessels.
